summary: Enbridge Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a US$1.1 billion offering of two series of 6.700%/6.875% fixed-to-fixed rate subordinated notes due 2057, each series totaling US$550 million. Pricing occurred November 9, 2026, with settlement November 13, 2026; interest is payable semi-annually from May 15, 2027, with five-year optional interest deferral and a dividend stopper. This is a routine investment-grade debt capital raise, not a special situation; no equity, ownership, or control implications. Watch credit spreads and leverage metrics rather than deal terms.
